facts.text: Make Brand Assets For Me is free, public, and MIT licensed.
Version 0.2.4 contains seven plain-language skills, including guided first-run help and Make My Launch Pack, with portable fail-closed typography and full-size placement checks.
The launch-pack renderer in this repository generated the coordinated graphics used for this worked launch example.
The cut-paper, soft-clay, and bold-print gallery brands are fictional demonstrations.
Lemonbrand offers a free 60-minute inbox audit through its public booking page.
